text: If you're hoping to squeeze in outdoor plans today, do it early: rounds of scattered showers build through the afternoon, with a few thunderstorms likely mid-afternoon into early evening. The high near 80 is believable, but the rain chance is the real story — NWS has it at 70%, and the European model is going even further, calling for rain essentially all day, while the American model is much drier. I'd bet on the wetter side given how the morning looks already. The lake's under a wind advisory early, south winds 15 to 25 knots before easing to 5 to 15 by afternoon, so broad waters will be choppy and unsettled before they calm. Things dry out and clear this evening, setting up a quiet night with lows near 63 and a much nicer Tuesday, partly sunny near 81. Keep the rain jacket handy through midday, and save the lake plans for Tuesday when the wind lays down and the sun's back.
